chapter: Ella, Charlie Christian and Europe with Hayes
title: Thelonious Monk wrote for Bud Powell
summary: Clarke says Monk left out the meaningless notes and wrote his piano music deliberately for Bud Powell, as a composer writes for a singer.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk
